title: Acridine Orange Staining Protocol
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ib3caqn

steps.title: Set up filtration apparatus
steps.instruction: Prepare the filtration system with the appropriate water and filters before adding the sample.

substeps.instruction: Form a meniscus with Milli‑Q H₂O (for freshwater) or ESAW (for saltwater) on the vacuum round.
Place a 0.45 µm HAWP filter onto the meniscus.
Turn on the vacuum to approximately 5 mmHg and close the knob.
Create a second bubble of Milli‑Q H₂O or ESAW on the filter.
Place a 0.2 µm GTBP filter onto the bubble.
Position the filter tower over the filters.

steps.title: Add sample and Acridine Orange
steps.instruction: Introduce the water sample and stain onto the filter.

substeps.instruction: Pour 2 mL of a preserved water sample (or a sample diluted to 2 mL with Milli‑Q H₂O or ESAW) onto the filter.
Add 10 µL of 1 % w/v filtered Acridine Orange (AO) (Fisher Scientific Catalog #AC423340010) and mix gently.
Keep the AO solution in a dark place when not in use and work under low‑light conditions.

steps.title: Incubate stain
steps.instruction: Allow the Acridine Orange to stain the retained material.

substeps.instruction: Let the filter stand for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse filtered material
steps.instruction: Remove excess stain and sample by rinsing under vacuum.

substeps.instruction: Vacuum‑rinse with approximately 2 mL of Milli‑Q H₂O or ESAW when the meniscus reaches the filter surface.
Perform a second rinse with the same volume of water.

steps.title: Disassemble and mount filter
steps.instruction: Prepare a slide and transfer the filter for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: When filtration is complete, remove the filter tower.
While still under vacuum, lift the membrane filter and place it onto a prepared slide.
Prepare the slide by placing five small drops of immersion oil on a cover slip and one drop on the slide, then set the cover slip onto the slide.
Lift off the cover slip, lay the filter onto the oil‑coated slide, replace the cover slip, and remove any air bubbles.

steps.title: View slides under fluorescence
steps.instruction: Examine the stained filter using the appropriate microscope settings.

substeps.instruction: Observe the slide with a Leica DM4000‑6000 epifluorescent microscope using the L5 (blue) filter, excitation at 482 nm and emission at 525 nm.
